question: The vassal who taste tested Momonosuke's food in Chapter 971 and the vassal who reported Oden's foul deeds to Sukiyaki in Chapter 960 are the same person, right? It seems he has been supporting the Kouzuki family for generations… When I had realized that, tears started flowing out. –
answer: Indeed. That's exactly the case. His name is "Banzaburo" (番三郎), he's a samurai that was picked by Sukiyaki in his youth and who is immensely grateful for that.
name: Hikuma
